signatures.description: DOGFOOD-010: backend read PROJECTS_PATH/CACHE_DB_PATH while CLI+README documented MYTHOS_PROJECTS_PATH/MYTHOS_CACHE_PATH -> server writes to unexpected dirs. Fix: app.config.ts resolveProjectsPath/resolveCacheDbPath helpers with precedence PROJECTS_PATH > MYTHOS_PROJECTS_PATH (CLI workspace-root semantics: basename==projects ? value : value/projects) > ./projects; same for cache. Also wired cli server.ts through the shared CLI resolvers (it had the same inline dup). Unit tests 8/8 + live probe: env MYTHOS_PROJECTS_PATH=/tmp/ws + POST -> entity under /tmp/ws/projects.
